title: The King's Chamber as an acoustic catalyst chamber

tellings.quote: So the king's chamber and the anti chamber within the great pyramid are acoustic catalyst chambers that catalyze the chemical reaction between sulfur dioxide and oxygen into sulfur triioxide to produce sulfuric acid.

plain: The King's Chamber and the antechamber inside the Great Pyramid at Giza were built as sound-driven reaction chambers, where acoustic energy helped turn sulfur dioxide and oxygen into sulfur trioxide and so produce sulfuric acid, according to a researcher named Geoffrey Drumm. He gives this to Michels as his own theory. If right, the pyramid would be a chemical plant rather than a tomb.
